caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, closed box with intricate, colorful patterns and designs on its surfaces. The box is shown in perspective with the lid and two sides visible. The lid features a series of concentric semi-circles filled with alternating geometric patterns in yellow, red, blue, and green, outlined with black. The two visible sides of the box both display symmetrical designs of stylized flowers with red, blue, yellow, and green petals in pink or red vases, set against a brown background. Along the vertical edges and the edges of the lid, there are repeating blue, red, yellow, and white wave or petal motifs bordered by fine lines. The overall color palette includes brown, red, pink, blue, yellow, green, white, and black. The drawing is set against an off-white, blank background, and the artist's signature appears at the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Box
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
